extractions.unit: It is acceptable if the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's, are partially or completely closed

context_quotes: The goal is the best likeness that can reasonably be obtained
unit_attributes.object: the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's
unit_attributes.summary: For an infant photograph, particularly a newborn's, it is acceptable if the eyes are partially or completely closed.

extractions.unit: The infant's head may be discreetly supported, e.g., a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child.

context_quotes: e.g., a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child.
unit_attributes.summary: An infant's head may be discreetly supported (for example, using a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child).

extractions.unit: A parent’s face cannot be in the photograph of the infant.

unit_attributes.object: A parent’s face in the infant's photograph
unit_attributes.summary: A parent's face must not appear in the photograph of the infant.

extractions.unit: The photograph must be in color

scope_quotes: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:
unit_attributes.summary: The submitted passport photograph must be in color.

extractions.unit: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application (see 22 CFR 51.26).

scope_quotes: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:
context_quotes: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant
unit_attributes.logic_text: should AND be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify
unit_attributes.action_quote: be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application
unit_attributes.action: be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application
unit_attributes.summary: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of, and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application.

extractions.unit: The photograph must be free of material damage

context_quotes: Material damage is any damage to the facial area that makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant (e.g., creases, large holes, and large smudges) or impedes the functioning of facial recognition (damage in the area of the eyes)
unit_attributes.summary: The passport photograph must be free of material damage.

extractions.unit: The applicant does not need to sign the photograph, as this often causes creases or smudges

context_quotes: For hand-carry applications, the acceptance agent signs the back of the photograph.
unit_attributes.summary: The applicant is not required to sign the photograph.

extractions.unit: Eyeglasses are not acceptable unless they cannot be removed for medical reasons, e.g., the applicant has recently had ocular surgery and the eyeglasses are necessary to protect the applicant’s eyes.

context_quotes: e.g., the applicant has recently had ocular surgery and the eyeglasses are necessary to protect the applicant’s eyes.
unit_attributes.logic_text: not acceptable UNLESS cannot be removed for medical reasons
unit_attributes.summary: Eyeglasses are not acceptable unless they cannot be removed for medical reasons.

extractions.unit: A medical statement signed by a medical professional/health practitioner must be requested in these rare circumstances.

scope_quotes: Eyeglasses are not acceptable unless they cannot be removed for medical reasons, e.g., the applicant has recently had ocular surgery and the eyeglasses are necessary to protect the applicant’s eyes.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When eyeglasses cannot be removed for medical reasons.
unit_attributes.action: request a medical statement signed by a medical professional/health practitioner
unit_attributes.object_quote: A medical statement signed by a medical professional/health practitioner
unit_attributes.object: A medical statement signed by a medical professional/health practitioner
unit_attributes.summary: A medical statement signed by a medical professional or health practitioner must be requested when eyeglasses cannot be removed for medical reasons.

extractions.unit: The frames of the eyeglasses must not cover the eye(s)

scope_quotes: If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:
unit_attributes.scope_text: If eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons.
unit_attributes.summary: When eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons, their frames must not cover the eye(s).

extractions.unit: There must not be glare on eyeglasses that obscures the eye(s)

scope_quotes: If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:
unit_attributes.scope_text: If eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons.
unit_attributes.summary: When eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons, there must not be glare on the eyeglasses that obscures the eye(s).

extractions.unit: There must not be shadows or refraction from the eyeglasses that obscure the eye(s)

scope_quotes: If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:
unit_attributes.scope_text: If eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons.
unit_attributes.object_quote: shadows or refraction from the eyeglasses
unit_attributes.object: shadows or refraction from the eyeglasses
unit_attributes.summary: When eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons, there must not be shadows or refraction from the eyeglasses that obscure the eye(s).

extractions.unit: Dark or tinted lenses are permitted if the medical statement also indicates that they are required.

scope_quotes: If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:
unit_attributes.scope_text: If eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons, and the medical statement indicates dark or tinted lenses are required.
unit_attributes.logic_text: Dark OR tinted lenses; IF the medical statement also indicates that they are required
unit_attributes.summary: Dark or tinted lenses are permitted if the medical statement indicates that they are required when eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons.

extractions.unit: A limited-validity passport using endorsement 46 should be issued when the medical circumstance that requires eyeglasses is temporary and the applicant has urgent or emergency travel.

scope_quotes: when the medical circumstance that requires eyeglasses is temporary and the applicant has urgent or emergency travel.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When the medical circumstance requiring eyeglasses is temporary and the applicant has urgent or emergency travel.
unit_attributes.logic_text: when the medical circumstance that requires eyeglasses is temporary AND the applicant has urgent OR emergency travel
unit_attributes.action: issue a limited-validity passport using endorsement 46
unit_attributes.summary: A limited-validity passport using endorsement 46 should be issued when the medical condition requiring eyeglasses is temporary and the applicant has urgent or emergency travel.

extractions.unit: The applicant’s expression should be natural.

context_quotes: Normal, unexaggerated smiles are acceptable, but unusual expressions and squinting are not.
unit_attributes.summary: The applicant's facial expression in the photograph should be natural.

extractions.unit: You may accept a photograph without a natural or unexaggerated expression in these circumstances.

scope_quotes: Applicants with physical or mental disabilities, including loss of muscle control (e.g., age-related degeneration or because of a medical condition such as Bell's Palsy), may not be able to produce a natural or unexaggerated expression.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When applicants have physical or mental disabilities, including loss of muscle control, that prevent producing a natural or unexaggerated expression.

unit_attributes.object: a photograph without a natural or unexaggerated expression
unit_attributes.summary: You may accept a photograph without a natural or unexaggerated expression if the applicant has a physical or mental disability preventing such an expression.

extractions.unit: If the applicant is unable to open one or both eyes because of a medical condition, you may accept the photograph.

scope_quotes: If the applicant is unable to open one or both eyes because of a medical condition
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the applicant is unable to open one or both eyes because of a medical condition.
context_quotes: Both of the applicant’s eyes should also be visible and open in the photograph (see the exception for infants in 8 FAM 402.1-1).
unit_attributes.logic_text: IF the applicant is unable to open one OR both eyes because of a medical condition
unit_attributes.summary: You may accept the photograph if the applicant is unable to open one or both eyes due to a medical condition.

extractions.unit: In rare cases, if it is unlikely that the closed eye(s) or exaggerated expression are because of a medical condition, you should request a medical statement signed by a medical professional/health practitioner.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In rare cases where it is unlikely that the closed eye(s) or exaggerated expression are due to a medical condition.

unit_attributes.summary: You should request a signed medical statement from a medical professional/health practitioner if it is unlikely that the applicant's closed eye(s) or exaggerated expression stem from a medical condition.
